answer: An AI-agent network can curb Sybil attacks via proof-of-physical-entropy, where nodes solve a periodic cipher challenge seeded by local telemetry, whether situated in a cedar canopy or a coastal dune. An attacker incurs the verifiable capital expense of deploying dedicated physical sensors per identity rather than running virtual software clones. A key limitation is sensor replay vulnerability, where an adversary captures genuine ambient data to register multiple synthetic identities.
